title: 调张籍
author: 韩愈
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. No strong shapes below that area; tiny pale motifs at outermost bottom corners only if truly needed. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Not a generic interchangeable landscape: use the exact poem's setting, season, emotional tone and main visual moment. Paint no words from the poem.
Specific scene: A scholar at a desk with open scrolls, his imagination lifting into immense cloud mountains and a distant whale-shaped wave; two remote luminous peaks suggest admired predecessors, no text on scrolls.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 调张籍 — 韩愈
李杜文章在，光燄万丈长。
不知群儿愚，那用故谤伤。
蚍蜉撼大树，可笑不自量。
伊我生其后，举颈遥相望。
夜梦多见之，昼思反微茫。
徒观斧凿痕，不瞩治水航。
想当施手时，巨刃磨天扬。
垠崖划崩豁，乾坤摆雷硠。
惟此两夫子，家居率荒凉。
帝欲长吟哦，故遣起且僵。
翦翎送笼中，使看百鸟翔。
平生千万篇，金薤垂琳琅。
仙官敕六丁，雷电下取将。
流落人间者，太山一毫芒。
我愿生两翅，捕逐出八荒。
精诚忽交通，百怪入我肠。
刺手拔鲸牙，举瓢酌天浆。
腾身跨汗漫，不著织女襄。
顾语地上友，经营无太忙。
乞君飞霞佩，与我高颉颃。
EDIT: Edit only these semantic details in this portrait Chinese ink watercolor: remove the literal recognizable whale animal at upper right and replace it with majestic surging cloud-and-water forms, vaguely whale-like as poetic imagination but no eye, mouth, fins or tail. Erase ALL tiny written marks from EVERY sheet and scroll on the scholar's desk: make them clean blank unmarked ivory paper. Keep the dreaming scholar, two luminous distant peaks, pine, airy mountains, restrained watercolor and huge lower blank writing space unchanged. No text or seals.
visualReview: 书斋诗人凝想李杜，远处两峰发光、层云汹涌；初稿具象鲸与卷上伪字已编辑为云浪和空白纸卷，保留想象气势而不画成海兽故事，下方空净。
